notes: GenApp's add-policy front end (LGAPOL01, LINKed with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA): it checks the COMMAREA and LINKs LGAPDB01 (which LINKs LGAPVS01) with it. The case runs every program of that chain in the same task ("programs"), LGSTSQ too (its error logger, "region" for its ASSIGN SYSID), with the back-end case's Db2 tables, VSAM file and data; the scenarios reuse genapp-lgapdb01's inputs (each "why" names its source) and add the front end's own paths: no-commarea (EIBCALEN 0: LGSTSQ, ABEND LGCA). short-commarea: EIBCALEN 20 < 28: '98'. WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE's IF EIBCALEN > 0 (and the IF EIBCALEN < 91 inside it) is never true: the paragraph is PERFORMed only when EIBCALEN is zero -- dead in practice, uncovered by every scenario. The SQL faults (M2) are the harness's, one per statement the tasks run.
